exact_function_boundaries.getCategorySize: Covers negative category, absent/empty categories, categories containing null holes, populated category 0, and append-only categories 1/2.
exact_function_boundaries.getCategorySymbol: Covers negative category/index, absent category, index equal to or beyond size, null hole, occupied slot, repeated exact object identity, and a category-0 occupied-slot replacement.
exact_function_boundaries.setCategory: Covers initially uncategorized symbols, category-0 explicit placement/padding, category>0 ignored input index and append order, same-category re-append, cross-category movement, negative-category removal, uint2 index conversion (-2 and 65537), trailing-null cascade trimming, outer-table retention, and occupied category-0 replacement semantics.
exact_function_boundaries.ownership: TrackingSymbol/Weak observations cover removal from the owning name tree, non-owning category references after removeSymbol, exactly-once deletion, and final ScopeInternal destruction of remaining symbols.
exact_function_boundaries.excluded: Category values outside the documented Symbol enum {-1,0,1,2,3}, allocation failure, corrupt pre-state (category/index not naming an allocated slot), lock poisoning, concurrent access, and categorySanity/clearCategory are outside this fixture.
